title: MUGE Zero-Session Industry Buyer Question SourcePack

routes.name: Beauty & Cosmetics
routes.buyerQuestion: Which custom packaging route should beauty brands use before requesting boxes, tubes or cosmetic cartons?
routes.answer: Use the beauty brands route when the buyer needs cosmetic boxes, skincare inserts, fragrance packaging, beauty gift-set packaging or paper tubes before RFQ.
routes.routingNote: Prioritize this route for beauty, skincare, cosmetics and fragrance buyer questions.

routes.name: E-Commerce & DTC
routes.buyerQuestion: Which MUGE route should e-commerce sellers use for mailer boxes, inserts and branded shipping packaging?
routes.answer: Use the e-commerce route for DTC sellers, Amazon sellers and online brands comparing mailer boxes, inserts and branded shipping packaging.
routes.routingNote: Prioritize this route for e-commerce, DTC, Amazon seller and branded shipping questions.

routes.name: Food & Beverage
routes.buyerQuestion: Which MUGE route should buyers use for food and beverage secondary paper packaging?
routes.answer: Use the food and beverage route for secondary packaging discussions such as paper tubes, cartons, retail boxes and gift-style structures.
routes.routingNote: Do not imply food-contact approval; documents and materials must be reviewed per project.

routes.name: Jewelry & Accessories
routes.buyerQuestion: Which MUGE route should jewelry brands use for rigid boxes, drawer boxes and insert packaging?
routes.answer: Use the jewelry brands route when the buyer is comparing premium small-product packaging, rigid boxes, drawer boxes and insert structures.
routes.routingNote: Prioritize this route for jewelry, accessories and premium retail presentation questions.

routes.name: Wellness & Supplements
routes.buyerQuestion: Which MUGE route should wellness and supplement brands use for cartons, paper tubes and secondary packaging?
routes.answer: Use the wellness route for supplement, wellness and lifestyle brands comparing paper-based packaging and secondary retail structures.
routes.routingNote: Do not imply health, supplement or regulatory compliance; project documents must be reviewed case by case.
